```{r inspect-fisheries-geodatabase}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# Define the location of the original fisheries geodatabase
fisheries_geodatabase_path <- here(
  "data",
  "raw_data",
  "DFO Fisheries Atlas",
  "Maritimes_Fisheries_Atlas_2019_2023.gdb"
)

# Inspect available spatial layers
fisheries_available_layers <- st_layers(
  fisheries_geodatabase_path
)

# Display layer names and geometry types
fisheries_available_layers
```
